Even millionaires live paycheck to paycheck

As some one who is well off, I see a lot of my friends parents who do this. Ya they have a nice car, they lease it, yeah they have a nice house, they are still paying off their mortgage after 20 years. After all this and three kids in private school (costing about 50k a year for high school) they have no money in the bank. They live right up to there means and if they were to get laid off tomorrow they would be absolutely fucked. One of my friends mom only has one set of workout clothes, my mom sees her spinning in the same clothes every day and when asked she said that she washes them every night, yet she drives a Lexus, has three kids in private school, a house in a prominent area etc etc etc. Just because people make a lot of money a year doesn't mean they don't live paycheck to paycheck.
That's a big difference between asking yourself "How much do I really need to eat to stay alive this week".

This is a dream from two or three nights ago and it's been in my mind every since because it was so disturbing. Some context: Even though it's a year out, I've been planning my wedding and have been saving pins to my Pinterest Wedding board. This DIY on how to create giant flowers was one of them http://greenweddingshoes.com/diy-giant-flowers/.

This dream took place in my elementary school's cafeteria, though everyone (including me) was of high school age (fun fact: I'm currently 28 y/o). The cafeteria was packed with groups of people participating in arts and crafts projects and our group was (surprise, surprise) creating gigantic flowers. Everyone was ripping up various colors and textures of posterboard-sized paper. I guess there wasn't enough to go around or maybe I didn't want to use paper, because I decided to use the skin on my legs.

Yes. My own skin.

I sat down on the tiled floor and just started working on my left leg below my knee, but above my ankle. It peeled off in one, smooth, 1/2-inch-thick chunk, as if the epidermis was just gently sitting upon my bone and muscles. I then began to tear it into strips for the flower petals. Any strips that were too small to use, I ate.

Then, for whatever reason, everybody started filing out of the cafeteria, so I never got to finish my project. Darn.

I know there were parts before this and parts after it, but that is the most vivid part. .. Oh no, I just remembered something else. It was before this part, but someone else was mutilated. Joy. I won't go into that.

Thanks for reading! I hope I have less-disturbing dreams in the future that I can share. :)
Dream logic: What's horrible and painful in real life is no big deal in a dream. Warning -- involves blood and skin.

Wow, thanks for sharing! It's surprising what we don't even flinch at in our dreams that would be horrifying in real life. It's always cool to be able to tie dreams back to real, tangible experiences like reading that DIY, though ^_^

Blizzard shows by implementing the Treasure Goblins, that they are interested in giving us alternative ways to earn gold. For anyone who doesn't know yet what they do:

Treasure Goblins have a chance to spawn in any battleground. Two Goblins spawn per map, one per side, before the Gates open. Treasure Goblins award 100 gold and a special portrait when killed. That is a sort of side daily quest - you get a quest per day to kill one. If you are in a game and one dies (anybody can kill it) you get the gold. They do not replace normal daily quests!
